description: Replace the extra addresses that get the monthly invoice email (at most 3; an empty list clears them). The business owner always keeps getting every invoice and cannot be removed. Requires the current owner role on the business.

business_id.description: Business ID (optional only when the token can access exactly one business).

emails.description: The full list of extra invoice email addresses. Replaces the current list; [] clears it.

name: set_billing_contacts
title: Set Invoice Email Recipients
